rooms.name: Entrance Lobby
rooms.notes: Main building entrance lobby facing north as per site orientation. Leads to staircase and parking. Vastu: main door north-facing is auspicious.

rooms.name: Covered Parking
rooms.notes: Dedicated covered parking for residents as per user priority. Sized to accommodate ~3 cars (approx. 24 sqm per car bay). Occupies a significant portion of the ground floor footprint.

rooms.name: Living Room
rooms.notes: Primary living space for ground floor unit. North-facing to leverage site orientation for natural light.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.notes: Open or semi-open dining adjacent to kitchen and living for contemporary layout.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.notes: Modular kitchen with utility/service access. South-east placement preferred per Vastu. MEP routing for water, gas, and exhaust required.

rooms.name: Bedroom 1
rooms.notes: Second bedroom of the 2 BHK ground floor unit. South-west placement preferred.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.notes: Master bedroom with en-suite bathroom. South-west placement as per Vastu for residential buildings.

rooms.name: Master Bathroom (En-suite)
rooms.notes: En-suite attached to master bedroom. Full fittings: WC, wash basin, shower. MEP wet zone routing required.

rooms.name: Common Bathroom
rooms.notes: Common bathroom serving Bedroom 1 and guests. Full fittings: WC, wash basin, shower.

rooms.name: Powder Room
rooms.notes: Guest powder room near entrance lobby. WC and wash basin only.

rooms.name: Balcony
rooms.notes: North-facing balcony off the living room. Provides natural ventilation and outlook to the street.

rooms.name: Utility / Service Area
rooms.notes: Washing machine point, drying area, and service access. MEP connections for water supply and drainage.

rooms.name: Internal Corridor
rooms.notes: Internal circulation spine connecting bedrooms to living areas and staircase.

response.floor_summary: Ground floor (Floor 0) houses the building's main entrance lobby, covered resident parking occupying a major portion of the footprint, and a single 2 BHK dwelling unit comprising living, dining, kitchen, master bedroom with en-suite, second bedroom with common bathroom, powder room, balcony, utility, and internal corridor — all arranged for north-site orientation with contemporary planning principles.
